Praha 4 — Prague, Czechia

Average day Average night

In detail

Praha 4 is one of Prague's 57 official mestske casti (city districts). Policie CR (the Czech national police) recorded 19,720 incidents here in 2024 across a population of 135,712 residents — a rate of 14,531 incidents per 100,000 residents, close to the citywide average. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy central/tourist district can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential district can show a low rate simply by having few incidents relative to its population. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Prague — real Policie CR incident data and real CSU population figures, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data is not split here by time of day, so both figures shown here are the same.

The rate counts against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy tourist, shopping or transit area can read higher without that meaning elevated risk per visit, and a very sparsely populated district can swing sharply from a handful of cases. Frequently asked questions

Is Praha 4 safe?

Wandroz currently rates Praha 4 in Prague, Czechia as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is Praha 4 safe at night?

At night, Praha 4 is rated as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Praha 4 a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Praha 4's day rating (roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Praha 4?

Not yet at neighbourhood level. Unlike London, this city does not currently publish an open, geolocated crime dataset at this level of detail (checked against the relevant local and national open-data portals — see the methodology page for what was checked).
